exposure: Multifaceted strategy to improve appropriateness of indications for cesarean delivery (feedback, training courses, resource allocation, publication of results)
outcome: Appropriateness of indications for cesarean delivery (overall, elective, emergency)
cohort: The study included 23,711 deliveries in the pre-intervention period and 29,627 deliveries in the post-intervention period from 41 hospitals belonging to the Spanish National Health Service.
finding: A multifaceted strategy was effective in increasing the appropriateness of indications for cesarean delivery and reducing associated complications and costs.
mod_finding: The strategy led to a decrease in the general cesarean rate by 1.19 percentage points and an increase in the overall appropriateness rate for cesarean delivery by 15.45%.
